case_title: PACIFIC BEARS CALIFORNIA LM/C SF VS BANK OF AMERICA NTSA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,220.00 FILED BY PACIFIC BEARS CALIFORNIA LM/C SF AS TO DEFENDANT BANK OF AMERICA NTSA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-28-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERT MAIL TO PEGGY MOULDIN BR MGR & VP B OF A RETURNED SIGNED.
